top_issues.issue: The error toast covers the failed message, including its 'Not sent' label and Retry button, which are the recovery path it describes.
top_issues.evidence: The toast spans x 393 to 887, y 645 to 691; the failed message row (Alex Rivera 10:53) sits at y 625 to 700, and its Retry chip at about x 508, y 688 is hidden under the toast.
top_issues.fix: Anchor toasts above the composer with an 8 pt gap (bottom = composer top - 8) and scroll the message list so the failed row stays above the toast, or put the error inline on the message and drop the toast. Add a 'Retry' button in the toast itself.

top_issues.issue: 'Show me as available while I use Wren' renders a ☑ text glyph instead of the checkbox widget, misaligned with every other checkbox.
top_issues.evidence: The glyph starts at x 382 (other checkboxes start at x 390) and its label at x 400 (others at x 408). It is circular, not the 14 pt rounded square.
top_issues.fix: Use the shared checkbox widget: a 14x14 pt box with a 4 pt radius and an 8 pt label gap, so the label starts at x 408 like its siblings.

top_issues.issue: Hyphens render with wide side bearings across the app, so 'On-call' reads 'On - call', and 'sign-in', 'go/no-go', 'full-text', 'third-party' and 'F4KQ-9TZW' are affected too.
top_issues.evidence: In the chat list, 'On-call' at x 128 to 181, y 120 shows about 4 px of space on each side of the hyphen at 14 pt; the same appears in 'Sign-in did not finish' (signin-failed, y 298).
top_issues.fix: Map U+002D to the font's hyphen glyph, or substitute U+2011 (non-breaking hyphen) from Inter in the text pipeline; check that the fallback font isn't supplying the glyph. Target a hyphen advance of about 0.33 em.

top_issues.issue: Selected rows are shown only by a near-invisible fill, which fails the 3:1 non-text contrast guidance for a state indicator.
top_issues.evidence: Selected chat row #e4e4e8 on #f6f6f7 = 1.17:1 (light); #34353c on #1d1e22 = 1.36:1 (dark). Switcher selection #e4e4e8 on #ffffff is about 1.2:1.
top_issues.fix: Add a 3 pt accent bar at the row's left edge (#a9530f light, #e88c3e dark, as the rail already does), and/or darken the selected fill to #d6d6dc light / #3d3f47 dark and set the name in semibold.

top_issues.issue: The Calendar and Calls detail panes have no top header bar, while Chat and Channel have a 52 pt bar with title and actions. The frame jumps between sections.
top_issues.evidence: In chats the header bar runs from y 0 to 52 with a divider at y 51. In calendar the title 'Design review: Wren 0.2' floats at y 66 to 92 with no bar or divider, and in calls 'Calls and meetings' sits at y 66 to 92.
top_issues.fix: Use the shared header: 52 pt tall, title at 15 pt semibold, subtitle at 12 pt, a 1 pt divider (#dfdfe3 / #303137), and actions (Join, Copy link) right-aligned in it. Content starts 16 pt below.

top_issues.issue: At wide sizes the message column is capped, but the header and composer stretch the full width, so the composer no longer lines up with the messages and the right third is empty.
top_issues.evidence: At 1920x1080 messages and day separators span x 380 to 1300, the composer spans x 380 to 1904, and the hover toolbar anchors at x 1298.
top_issues.fix: Cap the composer and hint row at the same maximum width as the message column (about 920 pt), centred or left-aligned with it, or let messages grow to about 1100 pt. Keep the header's right-aligned actions at the window edge.

top_issues.issue: Focus indication is inconsistent: the composer shows a 2 pt orange ring, while focused text fields in dialogs show only the resting 1 pt grey border.
top_issues.evidence: The composer's focused border is #a9530f (5.34:1 on white). The new-chat search field holding 'ra' has a 1 pt #8a8d95 border (3.07:1), the same as unfocused fields.
top_issues.fix: Apply one focus style to every text field: a 2 pt ring of #a9530f (light) or #e88c3e (dark), drawn outside the 1 pt border, on all inputs.

top_issues.issue: The multi-line composer is cramped and its scrollbar is misplaced.
top_issues.evidence: Draft lines are spaced about 17 px at 14 pt (messages use 24 px). A 4x18 px scrollbar stub floats at x 1181, y 732 to 752 next to the attach icon instead of along the right edge, and the top line is cut in half at y 552.
top_issues.fix: Use a 20 pt line height (1.43) in the composer. Put the scrollbar at the inner right edge of the text area, full height, with a minimum thumb of 24 pt. Add 8 pt top padding inside the scroll area, or a 12 pt fade at the top.

top_issues.issue: The Calls page is a long help document with weak grouping, and at narrow widths the people list truncates names badly.
top_issues.evidence: The gap from label (y 386) to description (y 414) is about 28 px, almost the same as the gap from description to next label (about 40 px). At 760 px, names truncate to 'Katherine ...' because two 32 px icon buttons take 76 px of every row. The Join input is 28 px tall, the Join button 32 px.
top_issues.fix: Collapse 'How calls work' and 'What works today' into a 'Learn more' disclosure, or move them to Settings. Put each label and its description 4 pt apart and items 16 pt apart. Show call and video buttons on hover or focus only at widths under 900 pt. Make the input and button both 32 pt.

top_issues.issue: The live call bar doesn't stand out from the meeting header and has no clear leave action, and the demo state contradicts itself.
top_issues.evidence: The call bar background #f6f6f7 sits directly on a #ffffff header with no divider. The only live cue is an 8 px green dot. 'In the meeting · just joined' appears above 'Meeting ended: 58 min'.
top_issues.fix: Give the call bar a tinted surface (for example #e8f3ec light / #1d2a22 dark), a 1 pt bottom divider and a live duration timer. Rename 'Close bar' to 'Hide bar' and add a red 'Leave' or 'Open call' action. Fix the demo data so the meeting is ongoing.

top_issues.issue: Image handling looks unfinished: thumbnails are cropped into meaningless slices, and the preview's zoom toggle and margins are weak.
top_issues.evidence: In composer-images, the third thumbnail shows fragments of two birds. In image-preview, '100%' is bare text beside a filled 'Fit' chip, and the 3072x256 image sits in a 928x634 grey box with 160 px window margins.
top_issues.fix: Fit thumbnails inside their box (letterbox on #eeeef0 / #2c2d33) instead of cropping. Give the remove badges a 2 pt white or dark ring. Render Fit/100% as a segmented control with a 1 pt border. Make the preview truly full-window (24 pt margins) and add Copy and Save actions.

top_issues.issue: Button sizes and text styles vary between screens and within button groups.
top_issues.evidence: Primary buttons are 14 pt bold and 32 px tall, secondary buttons 13 pt and 30 px. Calendar Join/Copy link are 28 px pills at 13 pt. Status-message Save is 14 pt next to Clear/Cancel at 13 pt.
top_issues.fix: Use one button height (32 pt) and one label style (13 pt semibold) for every button. Vary only the fill (primary #a9530f / #e88c3e, secondary transparent with a 1 pt border).

top_issues.issue: Secondary button and segmented-control boundaries are nearly invisible, so they read as text rather than controls.
top_issues.evidence: The secondary button border #dfdfe3 on #ffffff is 1.33:1 (dark #303137 on #25262b, 1.16:1). Unselected theme pills: #eeeef0 on #ffffff 1.16:1, #2c2d33 on #25262b 1.10:1.
top_issues.fix: Use #b8bac1 (light, about 2:1) or, better, #8a8d95 (3.07:1) as the secondary border. In dark mode use #6e7179 (3.09:1 on #25262b). Give unselected segments the same 1 pt border.

top_issues.issue: Switcher rows all use one generic chat icon, so people, group chats, channels and meetings look the same.
top_issues.evidence: Every row from y 200 to 590 shows the same 16 px speech bubble at x 368. The chat list uses 38 px avatars with presence for the same items.
top_issues.fix: Use 24 pt avatars with presence dots for people, the group or meeting tile for group chats and meetings, and # for channels. Add a muted 11 pt type label on the right ('Chat', 'Channel · Engineering').

top_issues.issue: Thread 'Reply' actions and card edges are faint.
top_issues.evidence: 'Reply' is 12 pt #4a4d55 text with no affordance. The card border #dfdfe3 on #ffffff is 1.33:1 (dark 1.37:1).
top_issues.fix: Make Reply a ghost button with a 16 pt reply icon, 28 pt tall, 13 pt label. Raise the card border to #cfd0d5 (light) and #3a3b42 (dark), or tint the card background #fafafb / #1c1d21.

top_issues.issue: The composer placeholder and markdown hint row wrap awkwardly at narrow widths.
top_issues.evidence: In channel-narrow, '@ to mention' wraps to a second line starting at x 330, while the first line starts at x 326. In call-bar (380 px) the hint row wraps to two lines.
top_issues.fix: Below 520 pt, drop the '· @ to mention' suffix and shorten the placeholder to 'Message <name>' or 'New post'. Hide the hint row or reduce it to '**bold** *italic* `code` ...' with a '?' popover.

top_issues.issue: The settings dialog is one long scrolling column with its content clipped at the bottom and help text mixed between controls.
top_issues.evidence: The last row 'Move Wren beside the call window' is cut at y 718. A 3-line 12 pt help paragraph sits between unrelated checkboxes (y 430 to 473). Dropdowns are 28 px with a solid triangle.
top_issues.fix: Add a left section list (Account, Appearance, Behaviour, Calls) or collapsible groups. Put help text directly under the control it explains, with a 4 pt gap. Use 32 pt dropdowns with the shared chevron icon. Add a 16 pt bottom fade on scroll.
